'while' is the script's OWN last checkpoint() label at that instant: the bridge cannot see which API call was in flight and does not pretend to, so checkpoint per item if you want each dialog attributed. From inside the script, revit_raised(since) returns the same records DURING the run - take len(revit_raised()) before an open and pass it back after to get exactly what that open raised. To let an open continue past its dialog instead of cancelling: `with dialog_answer('dismiss'): doc = app.OpenDocumentFile(...)` - around THAT call only.
